title: System accent host doors across desktop and Android

setup: Use only the synthetic S11 shell; no product source, branding, private assets, credentials, or user data.
Record frozen SHA, runner image, OS/session, display refresh, native runtime/webview, recorder details, and clock calibration in environment.json.
Start whole-session 60 Hz video and event capture before launch. Drive actual OS settings; never synthesize an OS event or count renderer injection as native delivery.
Use disposable runner System Settings Appearance UI; record setup-only Accessibility grant separately.
actions: The S11 fixture seeds its stored accent value as System; wait for reader-ready and confirm the System source before changing the OS preference.
Read NSColor.controlAccentColor independently in sRGB.
Select a different accent swatch through System Settings UI and read it back.
Observe NSSystemColorsDidChangeNotification through host, token mutation and first presented frame.
Try real swatches for a low-contrast sample; do not inject if none qualifies.

assertions.requirement: Read the selected OS accent independently and compare it with the host's sRGB value.
assertions.expected: Independent native readback and host snapshot agree within 1/255. NSColor.controlAccentColor converted to sRGB plus NSSystemColorsDidChangeNotification.

assertions.requirement: A real OS preference change produces the platform native event and exactly one correlated host update.
assertions.expected: Record native event, fresh sequence ID, cause, independent readback and host value. Missing delivery is FAIL or UNVERIFIED, never pass.

assertions.requirement: The event reaches accent tokens and the first presented frame within one measured frame.
assertions.expected: Correlate native event, host update, token mutation and first visible changed frame by sequence ID; at 60 Hz, no more than 16.67 ms.

assertions.requirement: One OS change causes one coordinated token update without reload.
assertions.expected: Exactly one accepted host update and token mutation per OS event; no reload or uncorrelated update.

assertions.requirement: The reader requires no permission prompt.
assertions.expected: No prompt from the accent-reader path. Accessibility/capture setup grants are recorded separately.

assertions.requirement: A real low-contrast OS accent uses the nearest valid colour from the test palette when the system can produce one.
assertions.expected: Try real OS palette choices and read each independently. If one is below 3:1 against the surface or below 4.5:1 for text on the fill, apply the nearest valid colour from the synthetic test palette. If none qualifies, mark conditional/UNVERIFIED; the separate injection proves clamp logic only.

cases.session: Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME session after independent portal probe
setup: Use only the synthetic S11 shell; no product source, branding, private assets, credentials, or user data.
Record frozen SHA, runner image, OS/session, display refresh, native runtime/webview, recorder details, and clock calibration in environment.json.
Start whole-session 60 Hz video and event capture before launch. Drive actual OS settings; never synthesize an OS event or count renderer injection as native delivery.
Run the portal probe first. Only execute the real missing-key branch if Read confirms the key absent. If present, mark NOT APPLICABLE and run the isolated fault case.
actions: Record portal interface version and independent Read result.
If key is absent, launch the real reader and select stored System.
Capture unavailable reason, System visibility and resolved token.

assertions.requirement: Independently confirm whether the portal key is absent.
assertions.expected: Record exact Read result and interface version. A present key means NOT APPLICABLE, not pass.

assertions.requirement: Without the key, System is hidden and stored system resolves to brand.
assertions.expected: System hidden; no raw system color; brand token applied without reader permission prompt.

cases.session: Isolated controllable D-Bus portal; adapter fault fixtures only
setup: Use only the synthetic S11 shell; no product source, branding, private assets, credentials, or user data.
Record frozen SHA, runner image, OS/session, display refresh, native runtime/webview, recorder details, and clock calibration in environment.json.
Start whole-session 60 Hz video and event capture before launch. Drive actual OS settings; never synthesize an OS event or count renderer injection as native delivery.
Use isolated Settings test service or safely disabled portal. This evidence proves adapter fallback only and never real GNOME live delivery.
actions: Run separate subcases for absent service, missing key/read failure, malformed tuple, out-of-range channel, and SettingChanged subscription failure.
For each, select stored System and capture status, visibility and brand token.

assertions.requirement: Absent portal service falls back.
assertions.expected: portal-service-unavailable; System hidden; stored system resolves brand.

assertions.requirement: Absent key/read error falls back and keeps discovered interface version.
assertions.expected: Fake service records key error; System hidden; brand resolved.

assertions.requirement: Malformed/out-of-range RGB is unavailable.
assertions.expected: Reject wrong shape, non-finite or out-of-[0,1] channels; hide System and apply brand.

assertions.requirement: Failed SettingChanged subscription is unavailable.
assertions.expected: portal-subscription-failed; System hidden; brand resolved.

cases.session: API 31 accelerated emulator on ubuntu-24.04; dynamic colour resource
setup: Use only the synthetic S11 shell; no product source, branding, private assets, credentials, or user data.
Record frozen SHA, runner image, OS/session, display refresh, native runtime/webview, recorder details, and clock calibration in environment.json.
Start whole-session 60 Hz video and event capture before launch. Drive actual OS settings; never synthesize an OS event or count renderer injection as native delivery.
Record API/build, wallpaper ID, system_accent1_500 ARGB, callback sequence, activity generation and permission-prompt state.
actions: The S11 fixture seeds its stored accent value as System; wait for reader-ready and confirm the System source before changing the OS preference.
Read the API 31+ dynamic resource and current system wallpaper ID.
Open the platform wallpaper picker, select a distinct synthetic test wallpaper and Apply; record which wallpaper/configuration callback fires and the new resource.
Recreate the Activity; record the non-native readback and verify the app-scoped listener remains attached.
Select and apply a second distinct wallpaper after recreation; record its callback, wallpaper ID/resource, sequence and first presented frame.

assertions.requirement: Real wallpaper/palette change reaches the dynamic-colour reader.
assertions.expected: Record the actual WallpaperManager or changed-fingerprint configuration callback, wallpaper ID and resource. The callback source and sequence must be visible; recreation/configuration reads without a changed fingerprint are not native events.

assertions.requirement: Native event reaches tokens and first presented frame within a 60 Hz frame.
assertions.expected: Sequence-correlated event-to-presentation <=16.67 ms.

assertions.requirement: Activity recreation restores current state without a fabricated OS event.
assertions.expected: Generation advances and current wallpaper ID/resource are reread with nativeEvent=false for recreation itself. A second real wallpaper change after recreation reaches the still-attached reader exactly once.

assertions.requirement: Reader uses no wallpaper/storage permission.
assertions.expected: No reader prompt, wallpaper file read or storage permission.

assertions.requirement: Accent changes leave identity colours independent.
assertions.expected: Accent follows OS sample after clamp; identity sample remains #6B5B45.

assertions.requirement: A real low-contrast dynamic-colour sample uses the nearest valid colour from the test palette when available.
assertions.expected: Try wallpaper palettes and independently read the resource. If any sample is below 3:1 against the surface or below 4.5:1 for text on the fill, the nearest valid synthetic test colour is applied. If none qualifies, mark conditional/UNVERIFIED; the renderer boundary case proves clamp logic only.

cases.session: API 31+ Android reader adapter fault fixture; no native wallpaper event
setup: Use only the synthetic S11 shell and AndroidAccentReader adapter.
Use the optional readSystemAccent fixture callback to return a resource failure. This proves unavailable fallback only and cannot count as a real OS event.
Record API, reason, stored enum, permission prompts and resolved token.
actions: Construct the reader with a callback that throws a resource-unavailable exception.
The fixture seeds stored accent as System; capture reader status, hidden control and resolved token.

assertions.requirement: API 31+ without a working dynamic-colour provider is unavailable and resolves stored System to brand.
assertions.expected: Reader reports dynamic-colour-resource-unavailable, emits no nativeEvent=true, hides System and applies brand without a permission prompt.
